text:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout triggered for inference-api: v3.2.1 -> v3.3.0
Traffic: 20% (eu-west)
Signal summary: 95p latency +220ms vs baseline; KVCache miss +14%; error rate nominal (0.3%). No auto-rollback triggered yet. :eyes:

release-manager: @mike-sre can you eyeball infra metrics? do we call stop/go?

mike-sre: on it. pulling dashboards now. initial thought: tail latency spike aligned with sustained KV cache miss, looks like cold-path thrash on a subset of hosts.

lina-ml: 3.3.0 enabled a new quantized attention fallback that touches prefetched kvcache slices. wondering if a config flag flipped. cc @alex.dev

alex.dev: I pushed a small fetch-change in the prep diff (prefetch=false for chunked inputs) — would explain higher miss rate. Noted in release notes but maybe underestimated.

sam.ops: error budget burn creeping for eu-west if this persists. Recommend hold at current 20% and avoid auto-increase.

release-manager: consensus check: hold at 20% for now, do not ramp. We need a stop/go from ops + SRE after quick mitigation.

mike-sre: agreed. I'll attempt a soft pin to previous version for eu-west while we investigate. If pin fails we should run a quick rollback.

release-manager: pin command if needed:
```
redwoodctl rollout pin --service inference-api --version v3.2.1 --region eu-west --reason "kvcache tail spike"
```

alex.dev: quick data point: sample queries hitting reranker show 2.4x increase in backend compute for long queries on 3.3.0. Might be triggering extra KV ops. Adding a targeted eval now.

mike-sre: starting pin now. will report progress.

deploy-bot: Action queued: rollout.pin requested by mike-sre for inference-api -> v3.2.1 (eu-west). Job id 45321.

mike-sre: pin executed, traffic pinned to v3.2.1 in eu-west. Verified 5/5 canaries flipped back. Observability: KVCache miss trending down.

deploy-bot: Rollout update: Canary traffic remains 20% but pinned to v3.2.1 in eu-west. Job 45321 completed.

lina-ml: thanks. I'll prepare a patch to revert the prefetch change for 3.3.0 and run a focused e2e on KV-heavy inputs.

sam.ops: keeping the hold. recommend no further percentage increases until next healthcheck (in 30m) and release-manager signoff.

release-manager: agreed. holding. mike-sre, please open a short post-deploy incident with the samples you collected. we'll reconvene in 30m or earlier if signal reappears. :memo:

mike-sre: opened incident INC-2029 with logs and sample traces. ping me if anyone spots regressions.

alex.dev: thanks — rolling a patch branch now. will link PR in the incident.

release-manager: stop/go = STOP (hold). will change to GO only after 30m checkpoint and signoff from SRE + ML. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
